{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine merino turtleneck, fitted, hip length, cream #EFE4D2, merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, ankle length, dark chocolate #3E2A20, lined wool-blend flannel
Textured blazer, slightly cropped, single-breasted, warm taupe-brown #7A5A43, wool-blend tweed
Thermal leggings under the trousers, ankle length, near-black #1B1815, fine merino jersey
Coat, knee length, straight cut, camel #B98B5E, water-repellent double-faced wool with a removable insulated lining
Ankle boots, low block heel, deep grip rubber sole, dark brown #2E1F17, waterproof leather with a warm lining
Thick socks, mid-calf, charcoal #3A3836, merino wool blend
Wide scarf, rust #8C3B2E, wool and cashmere
Beanie, ribbed, chocolate #3E2A20, merino wool
Gloves, dark brown #2E1F17, leather with cashmere lining
Structured tote, dark brown #2E1F17, water-resistant treated leather

This outfit stays within a neat business look, with a knit, tailored trousers, a textured blazer and ankle boots, while the lined coat, thermal layer and wool accessories handle a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The waterproof boots with deep tread grip on slippery paths and resist road salt, and the trousers end at the ankle so the hems stay clear of slush. The cream, chocolate and camel palette is warm and echoes her dark hair and brown eyes, and the rust scarf adds a bright accent near her face. The knee-length coat and the single column of dark trousers and boots keep the line long and tidy."}
